verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's own docs describe scheduling recurring tasks that run in the background. A Scheduled view lets you review active, paused and completed tasks along with their recent runs, and tasks can also start from Gmail, Slack or GitHub events. missing for 10: explicit documentation of one-off (single future-time) scheduling, detail on how results are delivered or notified back to the user, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule recurring or one-off tasks that run automatically and come back to me with results

citations.quote: Schedule recurring tasks to run in the background.
Review active, paused, and completed tasks and recent runs in Scheduled.
scheduled tasks can run when a supported Gmail, Slack, or GitHub event occurs
Use an event trigger to triage new email, summarize channel activity, or act on pull request feedback without polling on a fixed cadence.
